def slug(value):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', value.lower()).strip('-')


def model_name(key):
    return '%s %s' % key


def path(lang, key=None):
    if key == ORDER:
        name = ORDER_SLUG[lang]
    elif key == JAPAN:
        name = JAPAN_SLUG[lang]
    elif key == PRICE:
        name = PRICE_SLUG[lang]
    elif key == FINANCE:
        name = ua_finance_partners.SLUG[lang]
    elif key in order_models.TOPICS:  # SEO-CONTENT-001
        name = order_models.TOPICS[key][lang]['slug']
    else:
        name = HUB[lang] if key is None else '%s-%s-%s' % (slug(key[0]), slug(key[1]), MODEL_SUFFIX[lang])
    return 'seo/%s/%s.html' % (DIRS[lang], name)


def url(relative):
    return '%s/video/%s' % (ORIGIN, relative)


def money(value):
    return '{:,}'.format(value).replace(',', ' ')


def _years(cars):
    years = sorted({int(m.group(0)) for c in cars for m in [re.search(r'(19|20)[0-9]{2}$', c['name'])] if m})
    if not years:
        return ''
    return str(years[0]) if years[0] == years[-1] else '%d–%d' % (years[0], years[-1])


def _prices(cars):
    prices = [c['price_usd'] for c in cars if c.get('price_usd')]
    return (money(min(prices)), money(max(prices))) if prices else (None, None)


def _alternates(key, existing):
    links = [(lang, path(lang, key)) for lang in LANGS]
    ka = 'seo/gu/%s.html' % (HUB['ka'] if key is None else '%s-%s-%s' % (slug(key[0]), slug(key[1]), MODEL_SUFFIX['ka']))
    if ka in existing and key not in (ORDER, JAPAN, PRICE):
        links.append(('ka', ka))
    links.append(('x-default', path('uk', key)))
    return ''.join('<link rel="alternate" hreflang="%s" href="%s">' % (lang, url(rel)) for lang, rel in links)


# SPEED-001: tiles are one column on a phone and ~250 px wide from two columns up.
TILE_SIZES = '(max-width: 520px) calc(100vw - 32px), 260px'


def _tile_srcset(image):
    value = photo_copies.srcset(image)
    return ' srcset="%s" sizes="%s"' % (escape(value), TILE_SIZES) if value else ''


def _car_list(cars, lang):
    t = T[lang]
    items = []
    for i, c in enumerate(cars):
        stage = STAGES.get(c.get('stage'))
        details = ' · '.join(x for x in (
            ('%s %s' % (money(c['mileage_km']), t['km'])) if c.get('mileage_km') is not None else '',
            stage[LANGS.index(lang)] if stage else '') if x)
        image = ('<img src="%s"%s alt="%s" loading="%s" decoding="async">' % (
            escape(photo_copies.copy(c['image'], 'm') or c['image']), _tile_srcset(c['image']), escape(c['name']),
            'eager' if i == 0 else 'lazy')) if c.get('image') else ''
        price = '<span class="price">%s $</span>' % money(c['price_usd']) if c.get('price_usd') else ''
        items.append('<li><a href="%s">%s<div><b>%s</b>%s<span class="muted">%s</span></div></a></li>' % (
            escape(card_urls.preferred(c['url'], lang)), image, escape(c['name']), price, escape(details)))  # SPEED-002
    return '<ul class="cars">%s</ul>' % ''.join(items)


def _model_links(groups, lang, current=None):
    t = T[lang]
    items = []
    for key in sorted(groups):
        if key == current:
            continue
        low = _prices(groups[key])[0]
        label = model_name(key) + (' — ' + t['from_price'].format(min=low) if low else '')
        items.append('<li><a href="/video/%s">%s</a></li>' % (path(lang, key), escape(label)))
    return '<ul class="models">%s</ul>' % ''.join(items) if items else ''


def _page(lang, key, title, description, h1, body, ld, existing):
    t = T[lang]
    meta = '<meta name="%s" content="%s">' % (MODEL_META, escape('|'.join(key))) if isinstance(key, tuple) else ''
    nav = '<a href="/video/info.html">{terms}</a>'.format(**t)  # owner [N]: only «Умови»
    footer = ('UA ART COMPANY · %s · <a href="tel:%s">[N]</a> · '
              '<a href="%s">Google Maps</a>' % (escape(t['address']), schema.PHONE, schema.MAP))
    return ('<!doctype html><html lang="%s"><head><meta charset="utf-8">'
            '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">'
            '<title>%s</title><meta name="description" content="%s">%s'
            '<link rel="canonical" href="%s">%s'
            '<meta property="og:type" content="website"><meta property="og:title" content="%s">'
            '<meta property="og:description" content="%s"><meta property="og:url" content="%s">'
            '<link rel="icon" href="/video/brand/ua-art/favicon.ico">'
            '<style>%s</style>%s</head><body>%s<header><nav>%s</nav></header><main><h1>%s</h1>%s</main>'
            '<footer>%s</footer></body></html>\n') % (
        lang, escape(title), escape(description, quote=True), meta, url(path(lang, key)),
        _alternates(key, existing), escape(title, quote=True), escape(description, quote=True),
        url(path(lang, key)), CSS + site_header.CSS, ld,
        site_header.header(lang, {l: '/video/' + path(l, key) for l in LANGS}), nav, escape(h1), body, footer)


def _process(lang, order_href='/video/podbor.html'):
    t = T[lang]
    return '<h2>%s</h2><ol>%s</ol><p>%s</p><a class="cta" href="%s">%s</a>' % (
        t['how'], ''.join('<li>%s</li>' % escape(s) for s in t['steps']), escape(t['includes']),
        escape(order_href), escape(t['cta']))


def _order_href(lang, key):
    """The order page with Korea and this model chosen (the page ignores a model it does not offer)."""
    return '/video/podbor.html?strana=korea&model=%s-%s&lang=%s' % (slug(key[0]), slug(key[1]), lang)


def _faq(lang, fill):
    t = T[lang]
    pairs = [(q, a.format(**fill)) for q, a in t['faq']]
    if not fill['n']:
        pairs = pairs[1:]  # no price range without cars in the catalog
    html = '<h2>%s</h2>%s' % (t['faq_title'], ''.join('<h3>%s</h3><p>%s</p>' % (escape(q), escape(a)) for q, a in pairs))
    return html, schema.faq(pairs)


def hub(lang, cars, groups, existing):
    t = T[lang]
    low, high = _prices(cars)
    fill = dict(n=len(cars), min=low or '—', max=high or '—')
    faq_html, faq_ld = _faq(lang, fill)
    body = ('<p>%s</p>%s<h2>%s</h2>%s<h2>%s</h2>%s<p><a href="/video/katalog.html">%s</a></p>%s%s' % (
        escape(t['hub_intro'].format(**fill)), hub_texts.hub(lang, lambda key: '/video/' + path(lang, key)),
        t['models'], _model_links(groups, lang),
        t['cars'], _car_list(cars, lang), t['all_cars'], _process(lang), faq_html))
    body += '<p><a href="/video/%s">%s</a></p><p><a href="/video/%s">%s</a></p>' % (
        path(lang, ORDER), escape(t['order_link']), path(lang, PRICE), escape(t['price_link']))
    ld = schema.script(schema.dealer(lang),
                       schema.breadcrumbs([(t['home'], ORIGIN + '/video/index.html'), (t['hub_h1'], url(path(lang)))]),
                       schema.item_list(card_urls.for_lang(cars, lang)), faq_ld)
    return _page(lang, None, t['hub_title'], t['hub_desc'].format(**fill), t['hub_h1'], body, ld, existing)


def order(lang, cars, existing):

def _budgets(cars, lang):
    t = T[lang]
    bounds = (0,) + BUDGETS + (None,)
    items = []
    for since, to in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]):
        group = [c for c in cars if c.get('price_usd') and c['price_usd'] >= since and (to is None or c['price_usd'] < to)]
        if not group:
            continue
        label = (t['budget_up'].format(to=money(to)) if not since else
                 t['budget_from'].format(since=money(since)) if to is None else
                 t['budget_mid'].format(since=money(since), to=money(to)))
        names = ', '.join(sorted({model_name(c['key']) for c in group if c.get('key')}))
        items.append('<li><b>%s</b> — %s%s</li>' % (escape(label), escape(t['count'].format(n=len(group))),
                                                   (': ' + escape(names)) if names else ''))
    return '<ul>%s</ul>' % ''.join(items) if items else ''


def _range(cars):
    low, high = _prices(cars)
    return '—' if low is None else '%s $' % low if low == high else '%s–%s $' % (low, high)


def price(lang, cars, groups, existing):
    t = T[lang]
    low, high = _prices(cars)
    fill = dict(n=len(cars), min=low or '—', max=high or '—')
    rows = ''.join('<tr><td><a href="/video/%s">%s</a></td><td>%d</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td></tr>' % (
        path(lang, key), escape(model_name(key)), len(groups[key]), _years(groups[key]),
        _range(groups[key])) for key in sorted(groups))
    table = ('<h2>%s</h2><table><tr>%s</tr>%s</table>' % (
        t['price_models'], ''.join('<th>%s</th>' % c for c in t['price_columns']), rows)) if rows else ''
    budgets = _budgets(cars, lang)
    examples = sorted((c for c in cars if c.get('price_usd')), key=lambda c: c['price_usd'])
    pairs = [(q, a.format(**fill)) for q, a in t['price_faq']]
    if not cars:
        pairs = pairs[1:]  # no price range without cars in the catalog
    body = ('<p>%s</p>%s%s%s%s<h2>%s</h2>%s<p><a href="/video/%s">%s</a> · <a href="/video/%s">%s</a></p>' % (
        escape(t['price_intro'].format(**fill)), table,
        ('<h2>%s</h2>%s' % (t['price_budgets'], budgets)) if budgets else '',
        ('<h2>%s</h2>%s' % (t['price_examples'], _car_list(examples[:6], lang))) if examples else '',
        _process(lang), t['faq_title'],
        ''.join('<h3>%s</h3><p>%s</p>' % (escape(q), escape(a)) for q, a in pairs),
        path(lang), escape(t['hub_h1']), path(lang, ORDER), escape(t['order_link'])))
    ld = schema.script(schema.dealer(lang),
                       schema.breadcrumbs([(t['home'], ORIGIN + '/video/index.html'), (t['price_h1'], url(path(lang, PRICE)))]),
                       schema.faq(pairs))
    return _page(lang, PRICE, t['price_title'], t['price_desc'].format(**fill), t['price_h1'], body, ld, existing)


def model(lang, key, cars, groups, existing):
    t = T[lang]
    name = model_name(key)
    low, high = _prices(cars)
    fill = dict(model=name, n=len(cars), min=low, max=high, years=_years(cars))
    texts = order_models.KOREA.get(key, {}).get(lang)
    # A model text may name the advertised version (fuel): the title and heading show it.
    head = dict(fill, model=texts['name']) if texts and texts.get('name') else fill
    if cars and low:
        title, description = t['model_title'].format(**head), t['model_desc'].format(**fill)
        intro = t['model_intro'].format(**fill)
    else:
        title, description = t['model_title_empty'].format(**head), t['model_desc_empty'].format(**fill)
        intro = t['model_empty'].format(**fill)
        if texts:
            description = texts['desc']
    lead, about, faq_html = '', '', ''
    if texts:  # the model itself first, then the catalog state
        lead = '<p>%s</p>' % escape(texts['about'])
        about = '<h2>%s</h2><ul>%s</ul>' % (t['versions'], ''.join('<li>%s</li>' % escape(v) for v in texts['versions']))
        faq_html = '<h2>%s</h2>%s' % (t['faq_title'], ''.join(
            '<h3>%s</h3><p>%s</p>' % (escape(q), escape(a)) for q, a in texts['faq']))
    others = _model_links(groups, lang, key)
    about += _topic_links(lang, key)
    body = '%s<p>%s</p>%s%s%s%s%s%s<p><a href="/video/%s">%s</a></p>' % (
        lead, escape(intro), quick_form.block(lang, key), about,
        ('<h2>%s</h2>%s' % (t['cars'], _car_list(cars, lang))) if cars else '',
        _process(lang, _order_href(lang, key)), faq_html, ('<h2>%s</h2>%s' % (t['models'], others)) if others else '',
        path(lang), escape(t['hub_h1']))
    h1 = t['model_h1'].format(**head)
    nodes = [schema.breadcrumbs([(t['home'], ORIGIN + '/video/index.html'), (t['hub_h1'], url(path(lang))),
                                 (h1, url(path(lang, key)))])]
    if cars:
        nodes.append(schema.item_list(cars))
    if texts:
        nodes.append(schema.faq(list(texts['faq'])))
    return _page(lang, key, title, description, h1, body, schema.script(*nodes), existing)

    t, page = T[lang], order_models.TOPICS[name][lang]

def finance_page(lang, existing):

def pages(cars, kept_keys=(), existing=frozenset()):
    """All landing pages. kept_keys: models whose page already exists and must stay."""
    groups = {}
    for c in cars:
        if c.get('key'):
            groups.setdefault(c['key'], []).append(c)
    keys = set(groups) | {tuple(k) for k in kept_keys} | set(order_models.KOREA)
    for key in keys:
        groups.setdefault(key, [])
    listed = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if v or k in order_models.KOREA}
    result = {}
    for lang in LANGS:
        result[path(lang)] = hub(lang, cars, listed, existing)
        result[path(lang, ORDER)] = order(lang, cars, existing)
        result[path(lang, JAPAN)] = japan(lang, existing)
        result[path(lang, PRICE)] = price(lang, cars, {k: v for k, v in listed.items() if v}, existing)
        for name in order_models.TOPICS:
            result[path(lang, name)] = topic(lang, name, existing)
        result[path(lang, FINANCE)] = finance_page(lang, existing)
        for key in sorted(keys):
            result[path(lang, key)] = model(lang, key, groups[key], listed, existing)
    return result
